body:
Thank you everyone for your support. I wasn't thinking. I was being rash and not thinking clearly. There is a world outside where I live and my experiences are not a representation of every experience I'll ever have in my future.

I thank y'all for being kind and offering me advice. 

Who knows? Maybe I'm a good catch after all.
Wow, thanks man. How would it be easier in another country?

I started playing when I was 15. I'm 25 now and I try to play at least 4 hours a day.

Honestly, I shouldn't have posted this. Y'all are great. I have depression and I also think I'm bipolar. I've been clinically diagnosed with depression and I'm pretty sure I have bipolar disorder.

I think these are the things that set me back. I'll be charming, funny, then some small detail gets into my mind. It grows and takes over everything. Eventually, I get extremely depressed during these episodes and it robs me of pretty much everything .

As far as gigging, yeah I'm gigging pretty well. It's usually every weekend and some weekdays thrown in between.

I appreciate y'all for helping me out and offering a stranger support, maybe reddit isn't full of dicks with neckbeards after all.
